response.original_title: Pilak: The Manila Film Center Invasion
response.overview: On November 17, 1981, a catastrophic construction accident at the Manila Film Center leaves 169 laborers buried alive under quick-drying cement. As the political regime frantically covers up the tragedy to ensure the upcoming international film festival proceeds on schedule, a bizarre and chilling revelation unfolds within the tomb. Among the missing workers trapped beneath the concrete infrastructure, evidence emerges suggesting that one of the entombed individuals was actually an extraterrestrial being.
